foodOn.label: sea salt (efsa foodex2)

citation.source: FoodOn (foodon.org), an OBO Foundry ontology, CC BY 4.0. Matched via EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS4) search API against the live FoodOn ontology, verified 2026-08-19.

foodOn.note: FoodOn has no flake-specific crystal-form class in this session's search results; "sea salt" is the closest available class but doesn't capture the large, irregular flake structure that distinguishes Maldon-style salt from fine sea salt (see flaky_salt.json's own domainFacts.gramsPerTeaspoon note on that real density difference).
